title: perf(canary): add hysteresis and adaptive thresholding to performance canary detector and rollout guards
author: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce hysteresis and adaptive thresholding to the performance canary detector and integrate the improvements into rollout guards to reduce noisy flapping and improve automated rollback decisions. Motivation: canary decisions were overly sensitive to transient latency spikes during noisy workloads and infra churn which caused frequent unnecessary rollbacks and degraded rollout velocity. This change adds a configurable hysteresis window, an exponential moving average based baseline, and adaptive thresholds that scale with observed variance. It also extends the rollout guard API to respect hysteresis state and exposes configuration controls in the Console. Includes unit and e2e perf harness tests and benchmark results against the current detector to validate reduced false positive rate while preserving true positive detection of regressions.
